### 2026-10-16 – 14/10/26

**15h**

14/10/26
One main thing didn't work out - the boosters for the SLS abort system weren't properly connected to my main SLS rocket, so I had to make that a bit better.
Another HUGE thing that I discovered - to make the rocket have its iconic rust and white colour combo on the main tank, I had to do two parts or else the colours kept mixing to only white or only rust-orange. But keeping it as 2 parts meant that in the assembly they kept coming apart. To solve this, I built another assembly to mate-fasten them together and then add it to the main assembly.

15/10/26
Lots of progress and my RS-25 engines are also done! Now I can work on the two side boosters for SLS to complete the rocket before I go back to the launchpad stuff, like the connecting parts and the fuel tankers.
I have also extrude-removed a hole through the middle of the SLS to ensure I can get the side boosters to fit into it.
After using the slider mate, I realised that it is 'sliding' out of the hole and is not firm. Thus, I added limits on my OnShape to 0.001mm to restrict any movement. This allowed for the SLS to be fully made and joined.
It is such a beautiful sight!!!

16/10/26
Have now completed the tanks for air and gas refilling before launch. I am trying to do the other parts of the 39B as different part studios and mate them in the assembly.
